spans.s:
शौल्क शौल्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शुल्क), relating
to tolls or customs or taxes, levied (as a tax &c.); (अस्),
m. a superintendant of tolls or customs, a custom-
house officer.

शौल्कशालिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शुल्क-शाला), of or
belonging to a custom-house, derived from a custom-
house.
शौल्कायनि, इस्, m., N. of a Muni.

शौल्किक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to taxes or tolls;
(अस्), m. a superintendant of tolls or customs.

शौल्किकेय शौल्किकेय, अस्, m. (fr. शुल्किक),
a kind of poison (said to be produced in a country
called Śulkika; according to some the venom of a
kind of snake).

शौल्फ शौल्फ, अम्, n. a kind of vegetable
(commonly called Śulphā).

शौल्विक शौल्विक, अस्, m. (fr. शुल्व), a cop-
persmith.

सौल्विक सौल्विक, अस्, m. (for शौल्विक), a
copper-smith.

सौलभ सौलभ, आनि, n. pl. (fr. सु-लभ),
N. of particular Brāhmaṇas.

सौलभ्य, अम्, n. easiness of acquisition or at-
tainment; feasibility, facility.
